polishes.description: Pounce on beautifully protected and glossy nails with Swift Claw Top Coat! Our quick-dry formula adds a stunning shine to your manicure, while also keeping it chip-free and locked in place. Application Tips: No need to shake the bottle before use. This can create bubbles in the top coat that may transfer to your nails. Let your base color completely dry before applying our top coat. We recommend floating the brush over the nail and being sure to extend the top coat slightly past the edge of the base color. Wrap the tip of your claws to seal them in and decrease chances of chipping. Make sure to clean any polish off of your skin and cuticles as soon as you can otherwise this could cause early lifting of the polish.

polishes.name: Swift Claw Top Coat

polishes.description: 3 AM Zoomies is a light teal-based polish with a pink shimmer that shifts to gold. This polish is part of the Pawsitively Polished Facebook group Team Cat vs. Team Dog fundraiser. 3 AM Zoomies is representing Team Cat.The charity for the Cat polish is the Nashville Cat Rescue, a local rescue that helps cats and kittens in Middle Tennessee find their way into loving homes. From September 1 through October 1, every bottle sold adds $3 to the donation pot. At the end of the month, whichever team sells the most polish wins, and the entire donation goes to their charity. $12 | $3 from every bottle goes into the charity donationProduct Details Handmade in small batches 15 mL bottle with fan brush (also available in 5 mL mini) 2–3 coat coverage Cosmetic-grade pigments and glitters Use a base coat and top coat for optimal results Small variations are part of the magic.
